summary_markdown: Customer admin requests bulk permission assignment for onboarding. Current per-user setup is manual and error-prone. Workaround exists (spreadsheet + copy) but creates mistakes and weekly overhead.

feedback.what_help_is_needed: Bulk assign permissions/role templates to multiple new users in one operation (e.g., CSV upload).
feedback.customer_scenario_and_desired_outcome: When onboarding 30-50 new hires each month, admin configures each profile individually. Desired outcome is one-step role template application to selected users.
feedback.customer_impact: Manual setup consumes about 2 hours weekly and introduces configuration mistakes.
feedback.workaround_details: Customer keeps a spreadsheet and manually copies settings per profile. Workaround functions but is error-prone and inefficient.

priority.rationale: Recurring operational drag and error risk, but no explicit hard outage or compliance breach.

evidence.quote: We need a way to bulk assign permissions. Right now we open each profile one by one.
Usually 30 to 50 new hires. It takes about 2 hours each week.
We keep a spreadsheet and copy settings manually. It works but we make mistakes.

open_questions: Which permission sets are most frequently assigned together?
Is there an audit/compliance requirement for assignment history?
